checks.name: V33 release and cosmetic module installed
HTTP mode uses real IndexedDB, document mode explicitly temporary
Autoplay respects disabled hit sound on both audio paths
A judged note creates one procedural sound, not a double trigger
Pause stops active feedback voices and clears transient effects
Paused input cannot arm a stuck gameplay source
Delayed resume after leaving the song cannot restart hidden audio
Lost touch capture releases only its own source
Last device release ends the hold without a duplicate judgment
Native Web Audio and VFX remain bounded under 1000 feedback events
Effects do not mutate result, replay log or charts
Live zero-volume setting stops feedback voices immediately
COOL success draws halo and bounded spark rays
System reduced-motion disables particles and stage movement
In-game reduced-motion also uses a stationary ring
Reduced-effects option removes extra visuals but leaves judgments intact
Actual offline audio render has a finite signal and silent tail
New sound preference persists through the real settings handler
Refused preference save preserves the saved option and resets the control
Feedback settings fit a narrow viewport without clipped controls
Losing focus pauses play and clears all inputs and sounds
No unhandled JavaScript error in the full V33 flow

scope: Chromium software GPU; actual Web Audio. HTTP and native IndexedDB. No physical device or acoustic latency certification.
